{{Quote|I'm okay where I am, thanks. I meant that I like living with the Vevut family.|[[Mirta Gev]]|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
'''Clan Vevut''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], a conflict waged between the forces of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the [[Confederation]]. After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his neighbors, the veteran Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Novoc Vevut]] adopted their young orphaned [[Parent/Legends|son]], [[Ghes Orade]], in [[Gai bal manda|Mandalorian tradition]]. Vevut raised Orade, and the two lived together at [[Novoc Vevut's home|Vevut's home]] and workshop in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], Mandalore's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Orade met [[Mirta Gev]]—granddaughter of the current reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]—and the two began a relationship that led to the pair getting [[Marriage/Legends|married]]. The [[Wedding of Ghes Orade and Mirta Gev|wedding]] marked the initiation of Gev into the Vevut clan, and the celebration following their private marriage ceremony was held at the clan's Keldabe home.

==History==
{{Quote|When I adopted Ghes, we had a hard time accepting each other at first, too. And I'd known him all my life. His parents were my neighbors.|[[Novoc Vevut]]|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
Living in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Novoc Vevut]] owned a [[Novoc Vevut's home|home]] that doubled as a workshop where he crafted and repaired [[Blaster/Legends|weapons]]. At some point in [[Time/Legends|time]], Vevut's neighbors [[Death/Legends|died]], leaving their young son [[Ghes Orade]] orphaned. Vevut had known the [[Gender/Legends|boy]] his whole life, and with his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] dead, decided to adopt Orade in the [[Gai bal manda|Mandalorian tradition]]. The two did not get off to a pleasant start to their relationship, finding it difficult to accept each other in their new roles. In time, though, Vevut and Orade eventually grew closer.<ref name="Sacrifice" /> Vevut taught and trained Orade, and guided him through his ''[[verd'goten]]'', the traditional right of passage in Mandalorian culture that marked a coming of legal age.<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref>

[[File:Mandalorian_wedding.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Ghes Orade and Mirta Gev]]
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], both Novoc Vevut and his son, Ghes Orade, were called to the planet [[Drall (planet)|Drall]],<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core's]] [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> There, the two met with [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]—leader of the Mandalorian clans—at the local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] known as [[Zerria's Bar]], to discuss an offer from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[President/Legends|President]] [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]], who sought to enlist Mandalorian aid in defending [[Centerpoint Station]] against any attack from the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. Neither Vevut or Orade was enthusiastic about Sal-Solo's offer, and they soon departed the negotiation table in order to engage in a game of [[Cheg]] with a female [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] that was later revealed to be Fett's estranged granddaughter, [[Mirta Gev]].<ref name="Bloodlines" /> Following their initial meeting at the cantina on Drall, Orade and Gev began to develope a romantic relationship, and in need of a place to stay following the death of her mother, [[Ailyn Vel]], Gev came to live with the Vevut clan at their Keldabe home.<ref name="Sacrifice" /> As time went on, Orade and Gev's relationship grew more serious, and Gev took to wearing the traditional [[Gold/Legends|golden]] sigils of Clan Vevut on her [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>

When the Mandalorians were contracted by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]], Vevut, Orade, and Gev all took part in the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] against the forces of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]]. During the engagement, Orade [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] one of Mandalore's new [[Tra'kad-class transport|''Tra'kad''-class transports]], while Gev and Vevut boarded the [[Turbulent-class Star Destroyer|''Turbulent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']]. Gev gravely wounded Caedus' [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Tahiri Veila]], with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|stab]] to the leg, impressing Vevut with her combat ferocity. In the aftermath of the battle and the victory against [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Caedus, the Mandalorian [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] returned to Mandalore, where Gev and Orade were [[Wedding of Ghes Orade and Mirta Gev|wed]] in a private [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] ceremony. Vevut subsequently threw a celebratory feast at their Keldabe home, happy to welcome Gev into the ranks of Clan Vevut.<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|My grateful thanks go ''[...]'' to Tom Hodges, for giving Vevut and Orade a face...|[[Karen Traviss]]' acknowledgements at the start of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''|<ref name="Bloodlines" />}}
[[File:MandoFatherSon02.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Rejected ''Insider'' artwork featuring Clan Vevut]]
Clan Vevut members Novoc Vevut and Ghes Orade were first pictured in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article, ''[[The Mandalorians: People and Culture]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]] and illustrated by [[Tom Hodges]]. Initially identified only as a nameless Mandalorian father and son in the article,<ref name="TMPaC" /> the two were later featured in the novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'', the second entry of the multi-[[Author/Legends|author]] series, ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'', and also written by Traviss.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> Traviss continued to feature the characters in her subsequent ''[[Star Wars]]'' novels ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''<ref name="Sacrifice" /> and ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', introducing Boba Fett's granddaughter Mirta Gev into the clan via a marriage to Ghes Orade.<ref name="Revelation" />
